items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: And they had a boy playing trumpet and he could hit those high notes and the big number was 'Tiger Rag,' and they had Willie Smith in there... So when Jimmy went to the Cotton Club right after Duke left, my man asked him if he had gotten anybody to arrange... I went up there and I arranged two numbe

ctx.x: He sure did. He was the greatest -- to me he was the greatest, he had more soul for a guy like him. He could do more on a sax. Billy Smith was the next guy I thought was great. Used to be with Jimmy Lunceford.
Willie Smith. Tell me about some of these other piano players, some of these guys. What about --
Jelly Roll Morton, I used to meet him in front of the Lafayette Theatre, had his music under his arm, walking up and down, said he was going to make it one day. Jelly Roll Morton.
